name: adjust_hp
description: Adds hit points to a creature, or takes them away with a negative hpDelta, within 0 and its maximum.

hpDelta.description: With adjust_hp, hit points to add; negative takes them away.

name: apply_effect
description: Puts an Effect, such as a condition or a spell, on a token.

effect.description: With apply_effect, the Effect's compendium slug.

name: create_encounter_pool
description: Create an Encounter Pool. Adds an Encounter Pool and records its first Revision. DM only.

body.description: An Encounter Pool as the DM writes it.

difficulty.description: How hard a generated encounter aims to be, by the 2024 XP budget.

items.description: A creature a Pool can field, how often it is drawn, and how many an encounter holds at least and at most.

name: create_encounter_table
description: Create an Encounter Table. Adds an Encounter Table and records its first Revision. DM only.

body.description: An Encounter Table as the DM writes it. Without a regionId it applies everywhere.

items.description: One weighted line of an Encounter Table. An encounter lists its monsters, a pool names poolId, nothing has neither.
How many of one creature an encounter holds.

visibility.description: Secret checks show only the outcome; open checks show their roll on the Table Display.

name: create_loot_table
description: Create a Loot Table. Adds a Loot Table and records its first Revision. DM only.

body.description: A Loot Table as the DM writes it.

items.description: One weighted line of a Loot Table. An item names itemSlug and an amount, coins name coin and an amount, a table names tableId; amounts read like 3, 2d6, 1d4+1 or 4d6x10.

name: create_npc
description: Create an NPC. Adds an NPC and records its first Revision. DM only.

body.description: The editable fields of an NPC.

disposition.description: How an NPC feels about the party.

name: create_settlement
description: Create a Settlement. Adds a Settlement and records its first Revision. DM only.

body.description: A Settlement as the DM writes it; locationId places it on a world map.

name: create_shop
description: Create a Shop. Adds a Shop and records its first Revision. DM only.

body.description: A Shop as the DM writes it. restockDays is required when it restocks every few days.

restock.description: When a Shop restocks from its Loot Table.

name: delete_encounter_pool
description: Delete an Encounter Pool. Removes the Encounter Pool; its Revisions keep it restorable. DM only.

name: delete_encounter_table
description: Delete an Encounter Table. Removes the Encounter Table; its Revisions keep it restorable. DM only.

name: delete_loot_table
description: Delete a Loot Table. Removes the Loot Table; its Revisions keep it restorable. DM only.

name: delete_npc
description: Delete an NPC. Removes the NPC; its Revisions keep it restorable. DM only.

name: delete_settlement
description: Delete a Settlement. Removes the Settlement; its Revisions keep it restorable. DM only.

name: delete_shop
description: Delete a Shop. Removes the Shop; its Revisions keep it restorable. DM only.

name: end_effect
description: Ends an Effect.

name: get_automation_coverage
description: Get automation coverage. How many entries of each kind the rules engine computes fully, partly, or leaves to the DM.

name: get_campaign
description: Get a campaign. A Campaign's home with its settings, the caller's role and every Member. Members only.

name: get_compendium_entry
description: Get a compendium entry. One entry rendered for reading, with the conditions its text mentions.

ruleset.description: Restrict to one ruleset; omitted, the 2024 rules lead.

name: get_npc
description: Get an NPC. One NPC. DM only.

name: get_session_log
description: Read a session's Action Log. The Session's latest Actions, newest first, and whether each can still be undone. DM only.

limit.description: How many to return, newest first.

name: get_session_state
description: See a live session. What the caller may see of a live Session now; the DM sees everything. Members only.

name: get_spell
description: Get a spell. One spell with its rules text and the conditions it mentions.

ruleset.description: Restrict to one ruleset; omitted, the 2024 rules lead.

name: list_activity
description: List AI activity. The latest prep changes made through MCP, newest first, and whether each can still be undone. DM only.

name: list_campaigns
description: List my campaigns. The Campaigns the caller is a Member of, newest first.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page.

name: list_characters
description: List characters. The party's Characters. Members only.

name: list_encounter_checks
description: List Encounter Checks. The Campaign's latest 100 Encounter Checks with their seeds and what they produced. DM only.

name: list_encounter_pool_revisions
description: List Encounter Pool revisions. Every Revision of the Encounter Pool, newest first. DM only.

name: list_encounter_pools
description: List Encounter Pools. The Campaign's Encounter Pools. DM only.

name: list_encounter_table_revisions
description: List Encounter Table revisions. Every Revision of the Encounter Table, newest first. DM only.

name: list_encounter_tables
description: List Encounter Tables. The Campaign's Encounter Tables. DM only.

name: list_locations
description: List locations. The places on the Campaign's world maps an Encounter Table can belong to. DM only.

name: list_loot_table_revisions
description: List Loot Table revisions. Every Revision of the Loot Table, newest first. DM only.

name: list_loot_tables
description: List Loot Tables. The Campaign's Loot Tables. DM only.

name: list_npc_revisions
description: List NPC revisions. Every Revision of the NPC, newest first, with its author and origin. DM only.

name: list_npcs
description: List NPCs. The Campaign's NPCs. DM only.

name: list_sessions
description: List sessions. The Campaign's Sessions, newest first. Members only.

name: list_settlement_revisions
description: List Settlement revisions. Every Revision of the Settlement, newest first. DM only.

name: list_settlements
description: List Settlements. The Campaign's Settlements. DM only.

name: list_shop_revisions
description: List Shop revisions. Every Revision of the Shop, newest first. DM only.

name: list_shops
description: List Shops. The Campaign's Shops. DM only.

name: move_token
description: Moves a token straight to a hex, without spending movement.

name: place_token
description: Places one token. A monsterSlug or characterId gives it that creature's stats and name.

name: reroll_stock
description: Reroll Stock. Generates the Shop's Stock afresh from its Loot Table, scaled by its Settlement, and records it as a Revision. DM only.

name: restore_encounter_pool_revision
description: Restore an Encounter Pool revision. Brings the Encounter Pool back to a Revision, recreating it if deleted; the restore is itself a Revision. DM only.

name: restore_encounter_table_revision
description: Restore an Encounter Table revision. Brings the Encounter Table back to a Revision, recreating it if deleted; the restore is itself a Revision. DM only.

name: restore_loot_table_revision
description: Restore a Loot Table revision. Brings the Loot Table back to a Revision, recreating it if deleted; the restore is itself a Revision. DM only.

name: restore_npc_revision
description: Restore an NPC revision. Brings the NPC back to a Revision, recreating it if deleted; the restore is itself a Revision. DM only.

name: restore_settlement_revision
description: Restore a Settlement revision. Brings the Settlement back to a Revision, recreating it if deleted; the restore is itself a Revision. DM only.

name: restore_shop_revision
description: Restore a Shop revision. Brings the Shop back to a Revision, recreating it if deleted; the restore is itself a Revision. DM only.

name: reveal_area
description: Reveals hexes of the map to the party, or conceals them again with on set to false.

name: run_encounter_check
description: Runs an Encounter Check on an encounter table now; mode force guarantees an encounter and pick takes the entry you name.

entry.description: With a pick check, the index of the table entry.

mode.description: A normal check rolls the chance; force_encounter skips it and never draws Nothing; pick takes the entry the DM chose.

name: schedule_encounter_check
description: Schedules an Encounter Check for the next rest or the next Travel Leg.

name: search_compendium
description: List compendium entries. Entries of one kind in name order, one page at a time. Without a ruleset the 2024 rules lead the blend.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page.

kind.description: Which kind of entry to list.

ruleset.description: Restrict to one ruleset; omitted, the 2024 rules lead.

name: search_spells
description: List spells. Spells in name order, one page at a time. Without a ruleset the 2024 rules lead the blend.

class.description: Class slug whose spell list to show.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page.

ruleset.description: Restrict to one ruleset; omitted, the 2024 rules lead.

name: spawn_encounter
description: Places an encounter's monsters as enemy tokens on the free hexes nearest q, r, numbered when there are several. Undo it with undo_action to remove them all.

items.description: One kind of monster an encounter spawns, and how many.

name: undo_action
description: Undoes one Action of the Session by its Action Log sequence, as every live tool returns it.

seq.description: With undo, the Action Log sequence of the Action to undo.

name: undo_change
description: Undo a change. Undoes a prep change by its Revision id. A creation is deleted; anything else is restored to the Revision before it. Only an entity's latest change can be undone. The undo is itself a Revision. DM only.
